## Step 1: Configure source

1. Open WSO2 Integrator, click **More Actions**.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Migrate Integrations from Other Vendors**.
4. Select **TIBCO** as the source platform.
5. <!-- manual: Under Select a Project Folder or Directory, click Browse and select your TIBCO BusinessWorks project directory or a directory containing multiple projects. -->
6. <!-- manual: Under Source Layout, select one of the following: -->
7. <!-- manual: Single Project — The source path points to a single project directory. -->
8. <!-- manual: Multiple Projects — The source path points to a directory containing one or more project directories. -->
9. Select **Generate Report**.

## Step 2: Report generation

1. Select **View Full Report** to open the full HTML report.
2. Select **Save Report** to download the report for future reference.
3. Select **Configure Destination** to proceed, or **Done** to exit the wizard.

## Step 3: Configure destination

1. <!-- manual: Enter an Integration Name for your migrated project. -->
2. <!-- manual: Configure the project settings: -->
3. <!-- manual: Project Name — Name of the project (defaults to Default). -->
4. <!-- manual: Create within a project — Enable project mode to manage multiple integrations and libraries within a single repository. -->
5. <!-- manual: Select Path — Choose where to create the migrated project. -->
6. Select **Start Migration**.

## Step 4: Rule-based migration

1. <!-- manual: Select one of the following: - Enhance with AI — AI automatically resolves unmapped elements, fixes build errors, and improves migration quality. - Skip for Now – Enhance Later — Keep the project as-is. -->
2. Select **Start AI Enhancement** to proceed to Step 5, or if you chose to skip, click **Open Project** to open the migrated project or **Done** to exit.
